description: Atomic γ-4f W3C pytest harness — PythonBackend now emits a `test_w3c_{N}.py` wrapper alongside every generated `{N}_sm.py`. The wrapper imports the sibling SM via sys.path insertion (relative to the test directory, with `sce-python-runtime/` also added so `import sce_runtime` resolves without an installed package), drives `engine.advance_time(50)` until `reached_final`, and asserts the final state matches the W3C `pass` literal. SCHEDULED tests get up to 6 s of virtual time; SIMPLE tests resolve on the post-initialize macrostep.
